picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling a modified F-16 under the VENOM program, a landmark milestone toward scalable autonomous air combat with direct implications for future defense doctrine.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened a summit of UK government, industry, and research leaders to accelerate AI-driven hardware innovation in aerospace, energy, and defence, signaling a coordinated national push to rebuild industrial capacity.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: A major alumnus philanthropic gift is funding Georgia Tech's new Parker H. Petit Center for AI-Driven Health Innovation, seeding a large-scale institutional bet on AI for disease prediction and treatment.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center at its CU x NVAITC Symposium, a significant industry-academia partnership expanding AI research and talent development in Thailand.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: WashU Medicine co-founded the C-BRAIN consortium, uniting academia, pharmaceutical companies, and other partners around AI-driven Alzheimer's research, exemplifying the kind of large cross-sector collaboration reshaping biomedical AI.
picks.title: Home

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, working with Swiss rail operator SBB and partners at Empa, ETH Zurich, and MIT, built an AI forecasting model that improves next-day electricity-demand predictions for the national rail network, a real-world deployed system with tangible energy-grid benefits.
picks.title: Using future data to better predict Switzerland's rail energy demand

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell researchers developed an AI method that maps and scores human bone marrow samples for more precise diagnosis of a serious blood cancer, a clinically meaningful diagnostic advance.
picks.title: Mapping Human Bone Marrow Yields New Tool, Insights on Blood Cancer
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: A new Lawrence Livermore-UC Santa Barbara collaboration is using AI to model extreme plasma physics relevant to nuclear fusion, advancing national-lab science with potential energy and security applications.
picks.title: Lab Report: July 17, 2026 | Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University's GOFLOW system uses AI to reconstruct high-resolution ocean current patterns from satellite imagery, revealing previously invisible small-scale currents with implications for climate and maritime science.
picks.title: Seeing the Ocean Like Never Before

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn's Faculty of Medicine partnered with Cornell University on the BRIDGE-AI Summit to build AI-driven digital health ecosystems and medical education, extending academic AI collaboration across borders.
picks.title: นายกสภาจุฬาฯ ปาฐกถาพิเศษ ประชุมวิชาการ BRIDGE-AI Summit
